readings: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), compute two things: the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`) over its telescopes, ignoring missing values, and the number of telescopes. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Return one row with three values: the average of the kept phases' bandwidth averages, the total number of telescopes across the kept phases, and the average amount by which the kept phases exceed that mean. Don't round.
queries:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth) AS avg_kept_bandwidth,
       SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes,
       AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth) AS avg_excess
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth
